about_the_game:
Frostline Demo — The Last Communication Bridge in the Grip of the Ice Age

In a frozen world gripped by the Ice Age, you take on the responsibility and importance of managing the last telephone station in the city center of the Western Region. Amid an unrelenting struggle between the government and a secret organization, you are the final link controlling communications and identifying wanted criminals.

Your duty is to carefully listen to incoming visitors, monitor both their face-to-face statements and phone conversations, decide who may communicate according to strict government orders, and block those who violate the rules. Your moral choices shape the fate of the region and your own conscience.

🕹️ Demo Features

  • The demo story is completed by the end of Day 3.

  • Interact with over 30 different NPCs and uncover their personal stories.

  • Gameplay progresses each day with new customers, different decisions, and surprising events.

  • Go outside at the end of the day and complete various tasks.

  • Detect contradictions and suspicious behaviors in customer dialogues

  • Uncover the complex power dynamics between the government and the secret organization

  • Identify and neutralize wanted criminals

  • Your decisions lead to different endings—every choice matters

  • An immersive, story-driven communication simulation set in an atmospheric 3D environment

Frostline is a unique experience depicting a communication war in a cold and harsh era. As the last remaining telephone station in the city, become a bridge of hope for families cut off by the ice — survive through your words.
